title: Validate a page-matched picture-label recurrence control at the folio or quire level
statement: A matched picture-label versus sham comparison can detect planted local recurrences. In simulations, dependence in how pairs are assigned can inflate false positives when labels or even single folios are treated as independent. Establish a feasible sampling and matching plan before applying this control to manuscript images.
check: Before scoring, define genuinely searchable paragraph body, prespecified picture objects, non-target sham candidates, within-folio matching (word length, number of tokens, train-only frequency bin and label-slot class whenever possible), and a defensible independent cluster boundary. Review the matching without seeing recurrence outcomes. Reproduce the attached zero-dose false-positive checks and planted-power curve on fixed public synthetic layouts, including a role-blind one-table reuse control and a genuine matched label-only insertion. Report eligible objects, paired labels, folios, nonzero independent blocks, exact attainable tail and Wilson intervals for the simulated error and power. Only then consider a registered manuscript fact, with its exchangeability case and practice sample viability made explicit.

evidence.public_prerequisite_check: At public main e518428, the dynamic registry had 33 DRAFT, 16 DISAGREE and 2 AGREED annotation records. Both AGREED seats were f72v1. The active selection had no linked picture objects, and even the other seat has no paragraph lines. The official public ZL and IT evaluation commands returned no effective objects and all three picture-label metrics undefined. This is the reason for calibrating on synthetic cases at present.
findings: For 12 simulated folios with 12 matched pairs each, the no-bias independent-folio test reached 616/720 power (85.56%) at the 0.25 insertion dose. With page-local bias and independent folio orientation it was 223/720 (30.97%), and with the orientation shared within two-folio blocks it was 94/720 (13.06%). The attained positive insertion share was 17.5%, 17.2% and 16.9% of all pairs respectively.

At zero dose for that two-folio-block layout, there were 24/720 rejections with correct block exchange (3.33%, Wilson interval 2.25–4.91%), 77/720 with invalid individual folio exchange (10.69%), and 203/720 with invalid pair exchange (28.19%). Across all 18 layouts in this simulated scenario the maxima of the invalid methods were 12.22% and 38.06%.

For 24 folios × 12 pairs with shared two-folio orientation, power at 0.25 was 266/720 (36.94%), at 0.50 it was 693/720 (96.25%, Wilson interval 94.60–97.41%). The matching zero-dose correct-block rejection was 22/720 (3.06%, Wilson interval 2.03–4.58%). None of the studied biased layouts qualified at the 0.25 dose under the predeclared screening rule.

Under a one-sided exact sign exchange, at least five nonzero independent clusters are necessary at alpha .05. Even with five or more, ties and weak signals can keep the observed tail high. More marked objects on one folio do not add exchangeable blocks.

The project DSL on one fixed literal-token synthetic realization returned p=.0025 for both the declared labels and shams at dose zero, from 399 global label shuffles. The paired exact folio p was .6875. Adding 16 and then 31 true literal recurrences out of 96 pairs gave paired p=.296875 and .0703125 on that same illustrative layout. The positive rate comes from the planned grid of 720 worlds per row, not that single example.
evidence.scope: These are exact randomization tests for a sharp null inside this simulated assignment protocol, plus the single synthetic token implementation check. They provide a sensitivity and failure calibration, with evidence neither about the actual statistical power on the manuscript nor about historical links. Folio-constant latent orientation is deliberately a strong nuisance. Application to observational labels requires matched roles with a defensible exchangeability assumption, and picture-feature pair statistics that depend on two folios require a different null.

frozen_synthetic_plan.purpose: Synthetic positive-control calibration for the within-folio picture label versus matched sham contrast proposed in PR 602. No manuscript image judgments or manuscript outcome data are inputs.
frozen_synthetic_plan.effect: Each matched eligible pair holds distinct equal-length candidate words. The binary outcome is whether the designated label or sham appears in searchable running text on the same folio. A positive control independently adds one private label word in place of an equal-length filler whenever the label missed and its dose draw succeeds. Existing label hits and the sham slot are unchanged. We simulate the exact-word-hit indicators directly. Fixed matched pair counts give each folio equal weight. This is a simpler own-page endpoint than the own-minus-other-page score in PR 602.
frozen_synthetic_plan.sharp_null: Generate two unlabeled candidate streams before assignment. A fair coin per prespecified independent block assigns streams as label versus sham for all pairs in that block. Conditional on background outcomes and pairing rules, stream assignment is exchangeable at the block level by construction.
frozen_synthetic_plan.credible_layout_rule: For a screening recommendation require at least 80% lower 95% Wilson power bound, feasible exact p support, and a 95% Wilson upper bound at zero dose no greater than 0.065. Keep all configurations including small cases where p is unattainable.

tests.correct_block: Sum integer labelled-minus-sham own-hit differences inside each prespecified exchangeable block. Compare their sum to the exact conditional distribution of sums under independent whole-block sign flips. Include the observed orientation and all ties in the upper tail.
tests.folio_only: Same test with one sign per folio. Deliberate negative control if two folios have shared assignment.
tests.pair_only: Independent sign for each discordant matched pair, exact upper binomial tail. Deliberate negative control for correlated pairs.

frozen_synthetic_plan.uncertainty: Report 95% Wilson intervals over independent simulated worlds within each row. The same generated background and planting uniforms are shared over successively larger doses within each world. The controls quantify consequences of this synthetic mechanism and cannot establish exchangeability in the manuscript.

independent_exact_tail_check.fixture_domain: all vectors with 0 to 6 entries from [-3,-1,0,1,3], exact tie-inclusive agreement with complete sign enumeration
independent_exact_tail_check.example: Four independent orientation groups, each with three adjacent folios and equal nonzero contributions. Incorrect individual-folio exchange at alpha .01 rejects when all four signs are positive, 1/16, already above alpha.

literal_token_bridge.description: One preselected synthetic layout per dose. All switches replace a five-glyph filler in a P line with a five-glyph label assigned to that folio only. Label and sham lines are distinct L units and never searched as paragraph text. No private label repeats across folios, so DSL own-minus-other-page equals own-page hit rate on this bridge only.
